{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Structured wool-blend blazer in charcoal gray (#2F3336), tailored fit with notched lapels and a single-breasted closure, featuring a medium-weight woven fabric for insulation against the cold.
Slim-fit trousers in black stretch-corduroy (#000000), ankle length to accommodate winter boots, crafted from a dense, wind-resistant twill weave.
A merino wool turtleneck sweater in forest green (#1C4D2F), relaxed ribbed knit at the cuffs and hem for warmth without bulk, made of fine-gauge yarn.
Chunky leather-look ankle boots with a thick lug sole in matte black (#0A0A0A), waterproof membrane lining, and extra insulation to handle snow and road salt safely while commuting on foot.
This outfit works because it strictly adheres to your refusal against high heels, prioritizing traction and warmth for walking in deep snow at negative fifteen degrees. The layered composition provides necessary thermal regulation for a frosty autumn commute without sacrificing the neat business aesthetic required for your workplace. By choosing dark, water-repellent fabrics and a structured silhouette, the ensemble remains professional yet functional enough to brave icy conditions until you reach your office."}
